input.command:
python3 -c "
target='.....((((((((...((((((((((..((((..........))))..((((..........))))..((((..........))))..))))))))))...((((((((((..((((..........))))..((((..........))))..((((..........))))..))))))))))...((((((((((..((((..........))))..((((..........))))..((((..........))))..))))))))))...)))))))).....'
print('len',len(target))
# pairs
stack=[]
pairs={}
for i,c in enumerate(target):
    if c=='(':
        stack.append(i)
    elif c==')':
        j=stack.pop()
        pairs[j]=i
        pairs[i]=j
print('npairs',len(pairs)//2)
# unit solution
unit='UCGUGAGCCAAGGGACGA'
print('unit len',len(unit))
units=[(28,45),(48,65),(68,85),(113,130),(133,150),(153,170),(198,215),(218,235),(238,255)]
seq=['A']*len(target)
# fill units
for (s,e) in units:
    for k,p in enumerate(range(s,e+1)):
        seq[p]=unit[k]
# fill stems: for each pair, use G-C
for i,j in pairs.items():
    if i<j:
        # alternate to avoid runs; use G-C
        seq[i]='G'
        seq[j]='C'
print(''.join(seq))
"
